chunks: My father (peace be upon him) said: Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari narrated to me from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Sulayman ibn Dustusawayh, from 'Ajlan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Three types of people Allah will make enter Paradise without any accounting: a just leader, a truthful trader, and an elderly person who spent his life in Allah's obedience.
ai.seo_question: Who are the three people Allah admits to Paradise without accounting?
ai.summary: In Thawab al-A'mal, Shaykh al-Saduq records this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), emphasizing that these three categories—just rulers, truthful merchants, and elders devoted to worship—are admitted to Paradise without detailed reckoning (hisab). This highlights the spiritual value of justice, commercial integrity, and lifelong piety, reflecting the Shia scholarly tradition that links social roles with divine reward.
